summary: Amkor Technology filed an 8-K announcing its intention to offer $1 billion aggregate principal amount of convertible senior notes due 2031 in a private Rule 144A offering, with an option for initial purchasers to buy an additional $150 million. The notes are senior unsecured obligations guaranteed by subsidiaries that also guarantee its 5.875% senior notes due 2033, will pay semi-annual interest, mature July 15, 2031, and are convertible into cash and possibly shares. No price per share, premium, or conversion price is stated. This is a routine capital markets debt issuance, not a special situation. What to watch: market reception and conversion terms.
